payload.title: claude tiers displace host model defaults
payload.body: Since claude definitions carry a role tier, a host's settings `model`, ANTHROPIC_MODEL, and CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL without FORCE no longer move cratylus agents (Claude's own precedence: a definition's model beats defaults). Ruled within role routing: a default is not an override; --model and CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE=1 with CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL still win. The READMEs must say this plainly (docs rewrite, piece 4).
